# Rank Rise Recognize

> Rank on Google. Rise in revenue. Get recognised by AI.

Rank Rise Recognize is an SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency for Indian SMBs and D2C brands. We optimize websites to rank top on Google organic search and Google Maps, and ensure brands are cited and recommended by generative AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

## Core Services
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization): Technical audits, on-page fixes, local SEO, high-intent keyword ranking.
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Structured 40-60 word answer blocks, schema markup, Google AI Overviews dominance.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): AI prompt tracking, third-party entity citations, ChatGPT and Gemini brand recommendations.
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile setup, Google Maps 3-pack, review systems, citations.
- Content & Blogs: Research-led articles for humans and AI models.
- Performance Ads: Google Ads & Meta Ads management.
- Web Development: Fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready WordPress and Shopify sites.

## Pricing Structure
- Founding Client Packages: From ₹7,999/month + GST (locked for 6 months).
- Regular Retainers: Starter (₹22,499/mo), Growth (₹49,499/mo), AI Search Pro (₹53,999/mo), Category Leader (₹1,12,499/mo).
- 3-month initial commitment, then month-to-month.
